hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty)' 2>/dev/null); d=${f:+$(dirname "$f")}; d=${d:-$PWD}; b=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in main|master) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This repository is on main/master. Create a topic branch before editing (git checkout -b <topic>), then retry. Direct commits to main are prohibited - docs/research-guidelines/80-operations/repository-workflow.md"}}';; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *'git commit'*|*'git push'*) b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in main|master) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Refusing to commit or push on main/master. Create a topic branch and open a pull request - docs/research-guidelines/80-operations/repository-workflow.md"}}';; esac;; esac

b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in main|master) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"This repository is currently on main. Create a topic branch before making any edit; a hook blocks edits and commits while on main."}}';; esac
